assessment: This manuscript reports the first high-resolution (3.1Å) structure of a dynein–Lis1 complex. Guided by their cryo-EM structure, the authors make mutations to show that the two Lis1 binding sites (ring and stalk) on the dynein motor are important for both dynein's in vivo function in S. cerevisiae and for the formation of human dynein/dynactin complexes.
